facilities.fees: Electronics: small amounts free, car trunk $10 / SUV $15; TVs $5–$40; car tire off-rim $10 / on-rim $25; bike tire $5–$10

note: Hamilton County's HHW chemical program is event-based with registration; no permanent public HHW site. Year-round tires and e-waste: Cincinnati Recycling & Reuse Hub. Source: https://hamiltoncountyresource.org/recycling_guide/hazardous_products.php

facilities.name: Carr Center (Division of Waste)
facilities.hours: Recycling, shredding & computer/cell-phone disposal: Mon–Fri 9am–3pm. HHW: first Friday of each month only, 9am–3pm (next: Fri Dec 4, 2026)
facilities.accepts: E-waste: computers and cell phones (Mon–Fri; no TVs). HHW on first Fridays only: oil, cleaners, solvents, pesticides, household chemicals (latex paint not accepted)
facilities.notes: City of Cleveland residents only

facilities.name: Ridge Road Transfer Station
facilities.hours: Recycling: Mon–Sat 9am–3pm. Regular waste disposal: Sat 9am–3pm. HHW: first Friday of each month only, 9am–3pm (next: Fri Dec 4, 2026). Bulky/tire drop-off for residents (limits apply)
facilities.accepts: Passenger tires without rims (residents; up to 4 free dumps/year including tires; fee beyond 4 tires); bulky waste; recycling; HHW on first Fridays only (oil, cleaners, solvents, pesticides, household chemicals; latex paint not accepted)
facilities.fees: Free for qualifying resident drop-offs; fee may apply beyond tire/dump limits
facilities.notes: City of Cleveland residents only; proof of residency required for drop-off

facilities.name: Cuyahoga County Solid Waste District HQ (electronics drop-off bins)
facilities.hours: Mon–Fri 8:30am–4:30pm; seasonal Special Saturdays (closed county holidays incl. Veterans Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas)
facilities.accepts: Computer equipment, printers and peripherals; cell phones, tablets and handheld electronics (recycled by RET3 Job Corp.). NOT accepted: TVs, appliances, bulbs, batteries, smoke detectors
facilities.notes: Open to Cuyahoga County residents; marked bins in the building vestibule; no bags or boxes; don't leave items outside after hours. (216) 443-3749

facilities.name: East Richmond Road Convenience Center
facilities.accepts: Paints (20 gal/month/household), solvents, thinners, stains, varnish, motor oil, antifreeze, car fluids, lead-acid car batteries, cooking oil, fuels; passenger tires without rims (limit 4; no off-road or oversized)
facilities.notes: Richmond residents with proof of residency (license, utility bill, or registration). No pesticides, herbicides, fire extinguishers, asbestos, explosives. 804-646-4706

facilities.name: Richmond Southside Transfer Station
facilities.accepts: Passenger tires without rims (limit 4 free; $1 each beyond 4; tractor-trailer tires $5 each); large bulk items, appliances, brush/yard waste; glass, cardboard, aluminum cans, newspapers
facilities.fees: Tires: 4 free then $1 each (passenger); tractor-trailer $5 each
facilities.notes: City residents; no commercial/contractor debris. 804-232-8488

facilities.name: Henrico Springfield Road Public Use Area (West End)
facilities.address: 10600 Fords Country Lane, Glen Allen, VA 23059
facilities.accepts: Passenger/automotive tires (tire trailer; up to 4 included in trip fee, max 6 per trip); free drop-off of used motor oil, old gasoline, antifreeze and oil-based paints & solvents; lead-acid batteries; recycling; yard waste
facilities.fees: $5 per trash/tire trip (includes up to 4 tires; $5 each beyond 4); HHW items (oil, gas, antifreeze, oil-based paint/solvents) free; recycling and yard waste free; $20 per refrigerant appliance

Closed New Year's Day, Independence Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve and Christmas Day. (804) 727-8770. HHW program: https://henrico.gov/utility/solid-waste/household-hazardous-waste-disposal/

facilities.name: Recycling Drop-Off Center
facilities.address: 2829 Elysian Fields Ave, New Orleans, LA
facilities.accepts: E-waste (computers, laptops, phones, keyboards, monitors, printers, TVs limit 4, game consoles, cables, cameras); batteries (AA–D, 6V, 9V, lithium); light bulbs; tires (limit 5); glass (50 lbs); plastics #1–2; paper; cardboard; cans
facilities.notes: Orleans Parish residents only; businesses excluded. Household chemical HHW is annual Collection Day only (2026 was April 11).

facilities.name: Jefferson Parish Metairie Drop-Off Site
facilities.accepts: Waste tires (5 per resident per day); motor oil (5 gal/day), oil filters (2/day), antifreeze (5 gal/day), gasoline (2 gal/day); lead-acid batteries; cooking oil (5 gal/day); e-waste: flat-screen TVs/monitors, computers, laptops, tablets, phones, printers, cable boxes, game consoles, networking gear, UPS units. Not accepted: CRT TVs/monitors, light bulbs, copiers, stereos, toner
facilities.notes: Free self-service site for Jefferson Parish residents (driver's license or water bill required); commercial users may not drop off tires, auto fluids, e-waste or batteries. Unload items yourself. (504) 731-4612

facilities.name: Kawailoa Transfer Station
facilities.hours: Daily 7am–6pm (closed Christmas and New Year's Day)
facilities.accepts: Household trash, bulky items, large metal appliances, tires, lead-acid batteries, standalone lithium/lithium-ion/NiMH/NiCad batteries, propane and helium tanks, butane, MAPP, fire extinguishers, green waste

facilities.name: Keʻehi Transfer Station
facilities.hours: Mon–Fri 10am–6pm; Sat 7am–6pm; closed Sun, Christmas and New Year's Day
facilities.accepts: Lead-acid batteries; standalone lithium, lithium-ion, NiMH and NiCad batteries; household trash, combustible bulky items, metal items. NOT accepted: tires, large metal appliances, propane/helium/butane/MAPP tanks, fire extinguishers
